collections_visibility_public_since_shap.name: collections_visibility_public_since_shape
collections_visibility_public_since_shap.value: ("collections"."visibility" = 'private' AND "collections"."public_since" IS NULL) OR ("collections"."visibility" = 'public' AND "collections"."public_since" IS NOT NULL)

content_aliases_active_shape.name: content_aliases_active_shape
content_aliases_active_shape.value: ("content_aliases"."active" AND "content_aliases"."disabled_at" IS NULL) OR (NOT "content_aliases"."active" AND "content_aliases"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL)

contents_merge_shape.name: contents_merge_shape
contents_merge_shape.value: ("contents"."content_status" = 'active' AND "contents"."merged_into_content_id" IS NULL) OR ("contents"."content_status" = 'merged' AND "contents"."merged_into_content_id" IS NOT NULL)

contents_restriction_shape.name: contents_restriction_shape
contents_restriction_shape.value: ("contents"."public_safety_status" = 'allowed' AND "contents"."takedown_status" = 'none' AND "contents"."restricted_at" IS NULL AND "contents"."restriction_reason_code" IS NULL) OR ("contents"."public_safety_status" = 'blocked' OR "contents"."takedown_status" = 'removed')

input_attempts_selection_shape.name: input_attempts_selection_shape
input_attempts_selection_shape.value: ("input_attempts"."selection_token_hash" IS NULL AND "input_attempts"."selection_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("input_attempts"."selection_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "input_attempts"."selection_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

input_attempts_lease_shape.name: input_attempts_lease_shape
input_attempts_lease_shape.value: ("input_attempts"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "input_attempts"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("input_attempts"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "input_attempts"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

invitations_consumption_shape.name: invitations_consumption_shape
invitations_consumption_shape.value: ("invitations"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."consumed_by_account_id" IS NULL) OR ("invitations"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."consumed_by_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_lock_shape.name: jobs_lock_shape
jobs_lock_shape.value: ("jobs"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."locked_by" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL)

public.public_content_attributions_curre.name: public_content_attributions_current
public.public_content_attributions_curre.definition:
SELECT
      col.content_id,
      a.stable_handle,
      fp.display_name,
      fp.avatar_url
    FROM collections col
    JOIN contents c ON c.id = col.content_id
    JOIN filter_profiles fp ON fp.account_id = col.account_id
    JOIN accounts a ON a.id = col.account_id
    JOIN domains d ON d.id = col.domain_id
    WHERE c.content_status = 'active'
      AND c.public_safety_status = 'allowed'
      AND c.takedown_status = 'none'
      AND c.first_public_at IS NOT NULL
      AND col.collection_status = 'active'
      AND col.visibility = 'public'
      AND col.public_since IS NOT NULL
      AND col.filter_revoked_at IS NULL
      AND col.moderation_status = 'clear'
      AND fp.active = true
      AND fp.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND a.status = 'active'
      AND d.active = true

public.public_contents_current.name: public_contents_current
public.public_contents_current.definition:
SELECT
      c.id,
      c.public_id,
      c.outbound_url,
      c.normalized_url,
      c.canonical_url,
      c.first_public_at,
      c.visibility_version,
      c.source,
      c.content_type,
      c.title,
      c.author,
      c.published_at,
      c.cached_favicon_asset_key,
      c.ai_summary,
      c.summary_status,
      c.enrichment_status,
      count(col.id)::integer AS public_collection_count,
      c.created_at,
      c.updated_at
    FROM contents c
    JOIN collections col ON col.content_id = c.id
    JOIN filter_profiles fp ON fp.account_id = col.account_id
    JOIN accounts a ON a.id = col.account_id
    JOIN domains d ON d.id = col.domain_id
    WHERE c.content_status = 'active'
      AND c.public_safety_status = 'allowed'
      AND c.takedown_status = 'none'
      AND c.first_public_at IS NOT NULL
      AND col.collection_status = 'active'
      AND col.visibility = 'public'
      AND col.public_since IS NOT NULL
      AND col.filter_revoked_at IS NULL
      AND col.moderation_status = 'clear'
      AND fp.active = true
      AND fp.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND a.status = 'active'
      AND d.active = true
    GROUP BY c.id
